about: Long-term memory for AI coding assistants, so notes and context carry over between sessions and between tools.

prs.title: Each saved page gets its own short ID
prs.broken: Saving pages from the command line printed a short page ID, but it was the start of the ID, which is a timestamp. Every page saved within about a minute showed the same ID.
prs.changed: The command now prints the end of the ID, the random part, as the web view already did.
prs.matters: Each saved page can be told apart and looked up by the ID the command prints.
